card.name: Middle initials in author names
card.fires_on: The period after a middle initial in a person's name, mostly reviewer or author credits such as Linda J. Vorvick, MD. Also fires on other name pieces just before a surname.

modes.label: Initial period in credits
modes.description: The period after a single-letter middle initial in a reviewer or author name.
modes.example: Also reviewed by Linda J<<.>> Vorvick, MD, Medical Director

modes.label: Other name pieces
modes.description: A letter or name part inside a person's name, just before the surname.

modes.label: Digit in a risk figure
modes.description: A digit inside a decimal such as 1.24 for relative risk.
